title: Wall Retrieval Station
description: A wall-retrieval station where a player loops around an obstacle, times the rimmed puck, gathers it while moving up ice, passes to the next player, then gets the puck back for a shot.
coaching_points: Move the feet and keep the head up while collecting the puck along the wall.
Get all the way to the boards before gathering the rim.
Skate away from the wall after possession is established to create options.
Present a target, call for the return pass, and finish with a shot.

title: Pad Skating with Pass and Shot
description: A half-ice skating and puck-control progression using pads or cones. Players retrieve a puck, perform a selected skating or handling pattern, exchange a pass with a teammate, and finish with a shot.
coaching_points: Use the obstacle pattern to emphasize edge control and puck control.
Keep the head up through the skating portion.
Make the give-and-go pass while continuing to move.
Rotate the shooter into the passing position after each rep.

title: Full Ice Skating & Skills with 9 Variations
description: A full-ice cone progression with nine skating and puck-handling variations, including stops and starts, tight turns, figure eights, forward-to-backward transitions, and mohawks.
coaching_points: Accelerate between cone pairs and control speed into each skill.
Stay balanced through tight turns and figure eights.
Keep the puck under control when adding puck-handling variations.
Execute transitions and mohawks on both sides.

title: Puck Stack Races
description: A skating relay where players carry pucks by hand to a designated line and build a vertical puck stack. Teams race to complete the stack without knocking it over.
coaching_points: Use powerful strides on every trip.
Stay under control when arriving at the stacking area.
Focus on balance and coordination while placing the puck.
If the stack falls, rebuild it before continuing.

title: 2 on 1 to 3 on 2 High Man Backcheck
description: A continuous rush drill that starts with a 2-on-1, expands into a 3-on-2, and then sends the high forward into a backcheck role on the next rush.
coaching_points: Defensemen keep sticks in lanes and force the puck toward the outside.
Forwards communicate and support the puck through each rush.
The high forward transitions immediately into the middle-lane backcheck.
Backcheck with long strides and an active stick.

title: Box Tag
description: A confined-area tag game that develops edgework, deception, weight shifts, and tight turns while players evade a tagger inside a box or faceoff circle.
coaching_points: Use deception and weight shifts to change direction.
Stay low and balanced through tight turns.
Keep the feet active instead of gliding.
Adjust the size of the space to change speed and difficulty.

title: 2 V 0 to 2 v 2 Full Ice Backcheck
description: A continuous full-ice drill where two players attack 2-on-0, then immediately become backcheckers against the next pair coming the opposite direction.
coaching_points: Attackers use full strides and avoid overhandling the puck.
Read whether the pass or shot is available while moving at speed.
Backcheck through the middle with sticks on the ice.
Communicate between the two backcheckers and pressure the rush from inside-out.

title: 3 Speed Warm-Up Drill
description: A three-speed puck warm-up where players progress from controlled edge-driven skating to creative movement and then full-speed explosive skating while maintaining awareness.
coaching_points: Keep the head up and scan for open ice at every speed.
At the first speed, emphasize edge pressure and lateral puck movement.
At the second speed, add tight turns and creative changes of direction.
At full speed, push beyond the comfort zone while staying in control.

title: Chase The Rabbit
description: A partner chase activity where one player acts as the rabbit and changes direction through a confined space while the chaser follows with a puck, developing awareness, skating reactions, and puck control.
coaching_points: Both players keep their heads up and scan the space.
The rabbit uses pivots, tight turns, and traffic to create separation.
The chaser stays close while maintaining puck control.
Pair players with similar ability so the chase stays competitive.

title: Billy Purcell Off the Wall
description: A full-ice pass-and-follow warm-up where players repeatedly jump off the wall toward the dots, receive and move the puck to the next station, then finish the sequence with a shot.
coaching_points: Jump off the wall to create space before receiving or passing.
Practice receiving and moving pucks on both forehand and backhand.
Keep the head up through each pass-and-follow exchange.
Move immediately into the next station after making the pass.
